title: On a phone Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's arrow behaviour
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Have an open, uninvoiced work order for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field reading "Unassigned".
  • Use a phone screen.
  • Open the design pictures "phone-00-b-phone-details.png" (board 6.0) and "phone-01-b-phone-open.png" (board 6.1) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open the work order on a phone (a touch screen with no mouse pointer).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Tap the card's edit button to expand it.
  2. Tap Lead Technician.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card expands with the same control as before.
  • Without tapping them, Lead Technician and Service Advisor look as they do today: no arrow until tapped.
  • The Sales Representative field already shows its arrow.

Step 2:

  • The arrow shows once the field is tapped.
  • Its dropdown opens as today.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone)

  • S3-R4: “Nothing in the fields or the buttons depends on hover. On a touch screen the Sales Representative fields always show their dropdown arrow, as the + and remove x buttons always do. Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's behavior, where the arrow shows once the field is tapped.”
  • S3-R6: “On a phone the work order card opens collapsed, without Lead Technician, Service Advisor or the Sales Representative fields. They show after the card is expanded with its edit button, as Lead Technician and Service Advisor do today. The expand control itself does not change.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
